purpose: Teach: 暑かっ/お便り/大通り/用心/台無し/音読/円形/探究

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、夏、本当に、暑かったね、今年、外、遊ぶの、大変だったよ、本気で、ぼく、覚えてる。
lines.en: Mom, summer really was hot this year. Playing outside was so hard—I remember how tough it really was.
lines.style: Quiet, genuine recollection. Sho's voice carries the weight of a small observation, not complaining but documenting. Steady pace, matter-of-fact. A child learning that his experience is worth naming.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。お祖母ちゃんから、お便り、来ていたわよ、翔くん、お礼の返事、書きなさいね、約束、絶対。
lines.en: Yes. Grandma sent you a letter, Sho. You need to write back and thank her—promise me you will, okay?
lines.style: Warm but matter-of-fact. Yumiko's mothering tone—not harsh, but clear about expectation. Gentle emphasis on the promise. The voice of someone managing small responsibilities with grace.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 大通り、車、本気で、たくさん、通ってるね、ママ、お祭り、近いから、絶対、混雑するわよね。
lines.en: There are so many cars on the main street. Mom, the festival is coming soon, so it's going to be really crowded, isn't it?
lines.style: Sho's voice brightens with observation-into-concern. Not anxious, but noticing. Quick-paced as his mind connects things. A child thinking out loud, checking his thoughts against his mother's.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 夜道、本気で、用心してね、翔くん、お母さん、心配だから、絶対、明るい道、選んでね。
lines.en: Be careful on the dark roads, Sho. Mom worries about you, so you have to stick to the lit streets, okay?
lines.style: Quiet concern underneath. Yumiko's voice carries genuine worry but doesn't perform it—steady and clear. A protective mother speaking to her son's growing independence. Slight pause after his name, making sure he hears her.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お弁当、本気で、こぼして、ぼく、台無しにしちゃったよ、ママ、ごめんね、本当に、絶対、気をつけるね。
lines.en: I spilled my lunch, Mom. I ruined it completely. I'm sorry—I really am. I'll be more careful next time, I promise.
lines.style: Sho's voice is small and sincere, carrying real regret without dramatics. He speaks quickly at first, then slows on the apology. The earnestness of a child who takes responsibility seriously. Trailing softly on the promise.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 国語の宿題、音読、ちゃんと、できたかな、翔くん?本気で、頑張ったわよね、ママ、聞いていたわよ。
lines.en: Did you get your Japanese homework done—the reading practice, Sho? You really worked hard at it. Mom heard you, and I was proud of you.
lines.style: Yumiko's voice warms into genuine praise. She speaks as if sharing a small secret with him—I heard you, I noticed. Gentle, encouraging. The kind of attention that makes a child believe in himself.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 公園で、円形の遊具、本気で、楽しいんだよ、ママ、ぼく、お友達と、ぐるぐる、回って、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: The circular play structure at the park is so much fun, Mom. My friends and I go round and round on it. It's really the best.
lines.style: Sho's voice is animated and pure with joy. Fast-paced, excited but not squealing—the genuine enthusiasm of a child sharing something he loves. Open and unselfconscious. Slight lilt at the end, inviting her to understand.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、好奇心、本気で、強いわね、ママ、感心するわよ、いろんなこと、探究する姿、本当に、誇り、絶対。
lines.en: Sho, your curiosity is so strong. I really admire how you explore everything and ask about the world. I'm so proud of you—truly.
lines.style: Yumiko's voice is tender and close, almost intimate. She speaks slowly, letting each word land. The care is unmistakable but not heavy. A mother reflecting her pride back to her son. Warmth and gentleness throughout.
